answer: Customs entry puts a hard floor under the cost of a fake agent. The ACE portal checks the importer of record number against the tax id, the bond on file and the house bill of lading, and a duplicate IOR triggers a penalty case, a bond claim and an account suspension. Each fake importer needs its own 500 bond, a container slot at 2200 and a 90 filing fee, so a thousand clones burn 2.79 million before one entry clears. A meadow of invented addresses and a yarrow of borrowed names will not hide the missing signer, and the audit starts at the nadir of the bond list.
